messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "Manual claim routing slows down the high-volume motor team.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "date": "2026-09-19T09:57:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Our motor team handles high-volume cases and wants automatic assignment based on postcode and workload... manual claim routing slows them down too much.",
   "route": "onboarding"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-23T10:05:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Our motor claims team really prefers automatic claim allocation to balance workload and match skills efficiently — it’s critical for scaling without adding headcount.",
   "route": "onboarding"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-28T08:08:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Our motor team wants more automatic claim allocation based on postcode and workload, but commercial prefers manual control for complex cases — we need per-team configuration.",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-18T15:03:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Our motor teams are pushing for automated claim routing by postcode and workload, but our commercial teams need manual claim routing for complex cases — we really need configuration that varies by team to keep everyone happy.",
   "route": "onboarding"
  }
 ],
 "title": "Manual claim routing slows down the high-volume motor team."
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The claim is that manual claim routing slows down the high-volume motor team. All four quotes (from onboarding and support, Sept–Oct 2026) consistently describe a product gap: the motor teams want automatic claim allocation based on postcode and workload, with per-team configuration so commercial teams can retain manual control. This is a clear feature request describing a product limitation a squad could act on, not a pricing, staffing, or documentation issue. No quote is praise or answered by a help article.","verdict": "pass"}
